newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up seven cents to 15.16 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up seven cents to 15.16 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose seven cents to 15.16 ringgit ($6.06) a kg on support from European, Japanese and local buyers, traders said.
"The market is making up for the lack of activity yesterday," said a dealer. The Kuala Lumpur Tin Market closed four cents lower on Monday despite a surge on the London Metal Exchange on Friday.
Turnover rose to 173 tonnes from 155 on Monday. Bids totalld 203 tonnes against offers of 139. Dealers said Malaysian tin was still trading at a discount of $15 from $30 previously.
